    Interface ClassifyFeaturesOptions

    Options for Emap.ops.classifyFeatures — 属性分级烘焙。断点/类别与计数在 emap 侧计算（权威），mapshaper -classify 只收显式 breaks/categories/colors 做逐记录映射（spec §4.1 断点权威在 emap）。

    Example

    const res = await map.ops.classifyFeatures({
      source: 'census', target: 'tracts', field: 'pop', method: 'quantile', classes: 5,
      colors: ['#eff3ff', '#bdd7e7', '#6baed6', '#2171b5', '#08306b'],
    });
    interface ClassifyFeaturesOptions {
        breaks?: number[];
        categories?: (string | number)[];
        classes?: number;
        colors: string[];
        field: string;
        invert?: boolean;
        method: "quantile" | "equal-interval" | "nice" | "categorical";
        nullValue?: string;
        otherColor?: string;
        saveAs?: string;
        source: string;
        target: string;
    }
